Package hadur117.core.physics

Class PatternMimic

java.lang.Object
hadur117.core.physics.PatternMimic
public final class PatternMimic extends Object
MOVE-56: a mimic of a pattern matcher whose symbol is our lateral velocity truncated to a whole number, as AutoBot 4.2.1's gun reads us (dzlane/G/learn6/README.md). Each scan the enemy turns our lateral velocity, seen from where it stands, into one symbol and adds it to a history that lasts the whole battle, beside a running arc length (the sum of the unrounded lateral velocities). To aim, it looks for the latest 30 - 1 symbols, then one fewer, and so on, in the history that ends at least 102 ticks back, and aims at the bearing plus the arc length we travelled after the match over a bullet flight, over the distance.

Replayed offline on truth logs, this lands within half a robot's width of 64% of the bullets AutoBot hits us with (39% of those it hits BeepBoop with). As a member of the danger (MOVE-29) it puts the surf's kernel on that angle.

Pure: no engine types, no clock, no randomness. Duel only, off unless the table names the opponent.
